Switch space

A library that stays with your canvas.

Explore the proposed media flow for issue #11.

  1. Open Spaces and click its name to switch between Personal Space and your teams. Stock media is a separate source. Collections contain sample media.
  2. Search and switch between Uploaded and Generated.
  3. Select a thumbnail to preview it. Follow its source or a “Used by” node.
  4. Drag a card onto the canvas to create an asset node.
  5. Click a node’s + input to choose compatible media, or drop a card directly onto it.
  6. Try renaming or deleting an asset; Undo restores it.

Session-only demo. Uploads stay in your browser. Refresh or Reset demo restores the starting scene. Sample video is a still-image clip; sample audio is a test tone.
